Good evening arrivals crew,
The gate agent asked me to write about rest breaks

Keep this tight at the desk and keep the handoff notes clean. The Companion Animal Travel Desk needs every service change logged in the ledger as soon as it lands, especially when a traveler arrives with a nervous pet or a plan that shifts at the counter. <<FACT F078>> Watch the paperwork, watch the crate check, and keep the tone calm with the passenger. If Gabriel Brown or Jonah Hassan comes through with Bruno, make sure the care plan matches the species, temperament, and cabin fit before anyone moves on.

For the next arrival wave, I want the team to keep one eye on the waiting area and one eye on the quarantine room. <<FACT F027>> If anything looks off, flag it early and push the update to the supervisor without delay. We are not chasing drama here, just clean ops and a smooth transfer for every animal.

Also, please remind the morning crew that health docs must be current before acceptance. <<FACT F082>> If the paperwork does not line up, send it back and keep the lane moving. Stay sharp, take the breaks you need, and keep the desk steady for the late bank.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
